workflow: A process duplicates itself while process-wide bookkeeping allocations remain live.
The child inherits those allocations but its ordinary shutdown path does not reclaim all of them.
Leak-detection instrumentation runs as the child exits and classifies the residual allocations as a fatal failure.
The child returns a failure status instead of the expected successful status, causing the supervising workflow to report an error.
summary: Forked child exits with inherited unreclaimed state under leak detection
decision_reason: The failure is an instrumented leak during duplicated-process shutdown, which is materially different from the existing clusters’ mutex deadlock, deliberate crash handling, allocation failure, or ownership/use-after-free workflows.
